第 1653章 他们在上面（第1页）
他们在上面（他们在上面（第22页）于是接下来的一段路程。仙庭诸军都保持着沉默。直到他们来到一处充斥着无尽星辰的所在。在每一座星辰上。他们都能找到一座墓碑，和墓碑上镌刻的碑文。“这是，超级人类文明的牺牲者。”仙庭中，有人哀叹。“哎，他们牺牲在这里，也不知道，是谁为他们铸下的墓碑。”有人怔怔地看着这一座座遍布星辰地的墓碑，心中伤感。他们此刻也明白。他们走过的每一颗星辰的大地下，都埋藏着人类先烈的尸骸。诸军一边行礼，一边安静走过。等到走出了无尽星辰所在地。不远处。神山之巅已经十分接近了。这时。艾罗·塔伦才开口对他们说道。“诸位，我们刚刚走过的这一处墓葬群，其实只是元始神山上，无数墓葬群中的一小部分。”他往山巅一指。“在那个地方，葬着更多为众生牺牲的英灵！”众人闻言，齐齐抬起头颅，往上方看去。却只看到了一座高高的山巅，而一轮黄金大日，高悬于山穹之上，洒落黄昏的光辉。“哪里？”众人心中疑惑。而艾罗·塔伦这一刻却走到诺薇达莉的身旁，对她说道。“殿下，你想要见的天使文明诸军和也在那里。”“也在那里？”诺薇达莉闻言皱眉。她一路上走来，看见的皆是繁星文明的生子民，从未看到一位天使。现在，艾罗·塔伦告诉她，天使们在上面？这让她的心中升起不好的预感。

Chapter 1653 They are up there (page 1)
They were on it (they were on it (page 22)) and for the next section of the journey, all the troops in the fairy court remained silent until they came to a place filled with endless stars. On each star, they could find a tombstone and an inscription engraved on the tombstone. "This is the victim of super human civilization." Someone in the fairy court lamented. "Hey, they sacrificed here, and I don't know who they are. The tombstones cast for them. "Some people stared blankly at the tombstones scattered all over the star field, feeling sad in their hearts. They also understood at this moment. Under every star they walked, there were corpses of human martyrs buried. The troops walked quietly while saluting. When they walked out of the endless stars, not far away, the top of the sacred mountain was very close. At this time, Aero Taron spoke to them." Everyone, the tombs we just walked through are actually just a small part of the countless tombs on the Yuanshi Mountain. "There are more heroic souls buried there who sacrificed for all living beings!" After hearing this, everyone raised their heads and looked up. But they only saw a high mountain top, and a golden sun hung high on the mountain, shining with the light of dusk. "Where?" She was confused. At this moment, Aero Talen walked up to Novi Dali and said to her, "Your Highness, the angel civilization troops and soldiers you want to see are also there." Novi Dali frowned when she heard this. Along the way, she saw only the people of the Star Civilization, and she never saw an angel. Now, Aero Talen told her that the angels were up there? This gave her a bad feeling.
